band_justification: 36,000,000 has never appeared as a declared seed or root in the working tree or in any commit in the repository history. execution_parameters.provenance: inherited unchanged from the frozen development runners

interval: 95% family-stratified paired bootstrap for Part A, 95% paired bootstrap for Part B, 10,000 draws

metrics.chatter: switch classification with the unchanged 8/16/30 s windows

pairing: Common random streams per (family,index) for Part A and one shared generated realization per seed for Part B; all three policies see identical environments.

part_a_scripted.purpose: Same design as the original held-out block, so the corrected controller is measured on the design the pre-correction controller was measured on.

part_b_generated.purpose: Genuinely changing environments, the class in which V6 measured the corrections. Sized for precision, not for an expected result.

reporting_rule: The result is reported regardless of direction. No metric, comparator, family, sample size or decision rule may be changed after execution. The block is executed exactly once.

sample_size_justification.generated_note: 400 gives a 95% half-width of about 0.201 m, against about 0.52 m at the 60 seeds V6 used. Chosen for precision; the value was not varied to obtain any particular outcome.
sample_size_justification.method: Paired standard deviation of the per-pair difference in overall_rmse_m, taken from DEVELOPMENT data only (V6 at root 35,000,000 for generated; V5 Part A at root 31,900,000 for scripted). No held-out data was used to size this block.
sample_size_justification.scripted_note: The scripted paired SD is small enough that 6 pairs would reach the same precision. 30/20 seeds are retained solely to reproduce the original held-out design exactly.
